qc.genome_build_check: User must ensure shared genome build; matching IDs alone does not verify build

score_metadata.block_semantics: Legacy 200 chromosome-respecting genomic deletion groups; not independent LD truncation blocks.
score_metadata.migration: Exact archived L1,L2,L3,L4 arrays imported into GCMSEM schema; L2 correction is already applied once.

original_score_metadata.definition: L[q,j,b]=sum over all eligible reference targets k inbinb, samechr andabs(bp_j-bp_k)<=1Mb of minor-allele-oriented R_jk**q; HM3 rows and broader reference targets.
limitations: Target universe is limited to1.84M distributed reference panel variants, not all human variation.
Reference MAF bins/orientation and HWE genotype standardization derived from503individuals.
original_score_metadata.normalization: Mean-impute, center, minor-allele-orient, empirical Euclidean norm1. Diagonal fixed1.
original_score_metadata.q2_diagnostic: (503*L2-windowcounts)/502; diagonal preserved, not a genotype-specific unbiased estimator; diagnostic only

q2_ldsc.note: Standard LDSC finite-reference r² correction. Orders3 and4 remain raw plug-in powers; this does not solve their reference sampling error.

original_score_metadata.targets: All autosomal single-nucleotide polymorphic503EUR reference variants; excludes MHCchr6:25-34Mb and286known UKB/reference frequency-discrepancy variants.

warnings: Scores were computed earlier from signed 503-person EUR reference LD using a 1 Mb rolling window, not the block-truncated GCMSEM score command.
Deletion boundaries can cut LD neighborhoods; jackknife uncertainty is approximate and conditions on the reference.
Finite-reference correction applies to L2 only; higher-order reference uncertainty is not propagated.

gcmsem_analysis.comparison: same tags, source counts, L2/L4 and fixed inverse-L2 weights
gcmsem_analysis.source_ld_average: HM3-tag mean L2 within each MAF bin; representative-tag approximation

comparison.sld4m_reporting: Native ma(1), ma_se(1); no custom aggregation
comparison.interpretation: Independent pipeline comparison with different reference SNP universes; descriptive agreement, not a truth validation

checks.portable_raw_adapters: Height and GSCAN reproduced every cached chi-square and QC flag

limitations: Author-released 1000 Genomes example configuration; the 2019 main empirical analysis used UK10K
Different reference SNP universes and annotation models; correlation is descriptive, not accuracy against truth
GCMSEM conversion uses a Gaussian variance-mixture assumption and an HM3-tag approximation to source LD averages
Method-specific jackknife SEs condition on scores; errors across methods share GWAS information
Earlier matched-input r=0.9651 is not the independent-pipeline result
